changes.location: display:The new liberal democratic government of China has declared the victory over the old order and the liberalization of the regime as its primary and most important goal. The government carried out economic reforms in the direction of the free market, which dealt a serious blow to the economy, causing disorganization through the collapse of old ties, but the fight against corruption and fraud on the part of the young civil society in conjunction with loans and huge investments from the United States and the West allowed to gradually cope with the situation, entering into a state of a certain growth, which somewhat compensates for the former decline and even allows us to talk about some successes in economic growth and increasing social wealth, however, a huge share of income is concentrated in the hands of a narrow group of people - the nascent oligarchy, while millions of people leave China, hoping to find a better life abroad. The DPC is eliminating state control in all areas of public life, including political life, where there is an opportunity for the functioning of a minor opposition. In the Democratic Republic of China, as the country is now called, a regime of liberal democracy is being formed. Relations with the United States become friendly, and with the USSR deteriorate. The US is becoming the main economic partner of China, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is increasing. The USSR gradually breaks off trade relations with China and increases its military presence on the Soviet-Chinese border.

The DPC is eliminating state control in all areas of public life, including political life, where there is an opportunity for the functioning of a minor opposition. In the Democratic Republic of China, as the country is now called, a regime of liberal democracy is being formed. Relations with the United States become friendly, and with the USSR deteriorate. The US is becoming the main economic partner of China, the main creditor and investor of a young participant in the world market, whose dependence on developed countries is increasing. changes.before: 中国新的自由民主政府宣布：战胜旧秩序、实现政权自由化，是其首要且最重要的目标。政府推行面向自由市场的经济改革，这对经济造成了严重打击：旧的联系崩塌，导致体系失序；但年轻的公民社会在反腐败与反欺诈方面的斗争，叠加来自美国与西方的大额贷款和巨额投资，使局势得以逐步应对，进入某种增长状态——在一定程度上弥补了此前的衰退，甚至可以谈到经济增长与社会财富增加的一些“成就”。然而，收入的巨大份额集中在一小撮人手中——新兴寡头；与此同时，数以百万计的人离开中国，期望在海外找到更好的生活。中国民主党正在取消公共生活各领域的国家控制，包括政治生活领域——在那里，少数反对力量有机会运作。如今国家被称为“中华人民共和国民主共和国”，正在形成自由民主政体。与美国的关系变得友好，而与苏联的关系则恶化。美国正成为中国的主要经济伙伴、世界市场中年轻参与者的主要债权人和投资者，其对发达国家的依赖也在不断加深。苏联逐步中断与中国的贸易关系，并在苏中边境增加军事存在。

changes.location: display:On October 28, 1977, the guards of the Jincheng Prison found Panchen-Lamu X on the floor of his cell without signs of life. In the morning of the same day, under the guise of the injection of a tonic substance, he was injected with a special poison, which provoked myocardial infarction. Although the newspaper "Sitszan zhibao" (an organ of the Tibetan Council of People’s Representatives) published an official communique in which the cause of death was called a heart attack, few people believed it. The autonomy has already openly said that the "Panchen Lama was killed by the MSS for disagreeing with the Chinese annexation of Tibet"... The head of the committee on the search for the new Panchen Lama, appointed by our approval, secretly maintained contact with the fugitive Dalai Lama that did not hide from the attention of the MSS. Rinpoche was arrested and replaced by Sengchen Lobsang Gyaltsen, who was a political opponent of both the Dalai Lama and the late Panchen Lama. He achieved the outcome we needed - on November 11 a new 11th Panchen Lama was declared. "Buddhism made a solemn oath to the state and society to protect the country and work for the good of the people. Chinese society is a favorable environment for the Buddhist faith", Norbu said. He also praised his predecessor for the "outstanding contribution to strengthening the unity of the country and the solidarity of its people". However, 14th Dalai Lama and his so-called "Tibetan government in exile" declared the new Panchen Lama XI a little baby from Tibetan territory. We had to send him to a state orphanage... Tibetan clergy sabotage the activities of the new Panchen Lama and support the Dalai Lama's appointee, separatist sentiments spread among them...

changes.before: 1977年10月28日，金城监狱的看守发现班禅喇嘛X倒在牢房地上，已无生命迹象。同日早晨，借口注射“补品”，实则给他注射了一种特殊毒药，引发心肌梗死。尽管《西藏日报》（西藏人民代表大会机关报）刊登了官方通告，称死因是心脏病发作，但相信的人并不多。自治区方面早已公开说：“班禅喇嘛因不同意中国吞并西藏而被中共中央情报部门（国家安全部）杀害”……由我们批准任命的寻找新班禅喇嘛委员会负责人，暗中与逃亡的达赖喇嘛保持联系，而达赖喇嘛并未躲过中共中央情报部门的注意。仁波切被捕，随后由桑臣·罗桑坚赞顶替；他是达赖喇嘛与已故班禅喇嘛的共同政治对手。他达成了我们所需要的结果——11月11日宣布了新的第十一世班禅喇嘛。诺布说：“佛教向国家和社会作出庄严誓言：保卫国家、为人民的利益而工作。中国社会是佛教信仰的有利环境。”他还称赞前任对“加强国家统一、增进人民团结所作出的杰出贡献”。然而，第十四世达赖喇嘛及其所谓“藏人流亡政府”却宣称新任第十一世班禅喇嘛只是“藏地的一名小孩”。我们只好把他送进国家孤儿院……藏传僧侣破坏新班禅喇嘛的活动，并支持达赖喇嘛的任命者；分裂情绪在他们中间蔓延……

Of course, even small austerity measures have displeased Romanian citizens, but nothing that Ceausescu could not cope with. According to our estimates, at this rate he will be able to pay off debts by the end of the 80's without serious consequences for the economy and living standards.

changes.before: 他亲自打电话给勃列日涅夫，表示罗马尼亚的局势直接威胁到在罗马尼亚建设社会主义的事业以及整个苏联阵营的稳定，因此其解决必须覆盖整个社会主义阵营。苏联领导人支持我们的设想，于是召集了经互会（经济互助委员会）特别会议，决定以无偿的货币援助形式，向罗马尼亚提供偿债援助，并给予罗马尼亚对经互会的优惠进出口条件（当然，主要费用由我们和苏联承担）。齐奥塞斯库感谢我们及经互会其他成员的帮助，并已宣布对紧缩体制作出调整，旨在缓和它。当然，即便是小规模的紧缩措施也让罗马尼亚市民不满，但这对齐奥塞斯库来说并非难以应付。按我们的估算，以这种速度，他将在80年代末在不对经济与生活水平造成严重后果的情况下还清债务。

And this is our chance to intervene and stop the spread of Soviet hegemony.
changes.before: 1977年黎德寿赴莫斯科之后，越南与苏联的进一步靠拢开始了，前景是加入经互会（经济互助委员会），而他打算“日复一日”地加入。然而，国家领导层中的一部分人反对这种对苏联过于热烈的靠拢，因为对越南并不存在特殊威胁——尤其是在亚洲、波尔布特在柬埔寨被推翻之后。于是，这就是我们介入并阻止苏联霸权扩散的机会。
changes.after: 1977年黎德寿赴莫斯科之后，越南与苏联的进一步靠拢开始了，前景是加入经互会，而他打算“日复一日”地加入。然而，国家领导层中的一部分人反对这种对苏联过于热烈的靠拢，因为对越南并不存在特殊威胁——尤其是在亚洲、波尔布特在柬埔寨被推翻之后。于是，这就是我们介入并阻止苏联霸权扩散的机会。

changes.location: display:After Le Duan’s trip to Moscow in 1977, a further rapprochement of Vietnam and the USSR began with the prospect of joining the CMEA, which he intends to join from day to day. We apparently can not prevent this, not least because of the fact that Vietnam wants to enlist Soviet support against Pol Pot in pro-Chinese Cambodia.
changes.en: After Le Duan’s trip to Moscow in 1977, a further rapprochement of Vietnam and the USSR began with the prospect of joining the CMEA, which he intends to join from day to day. We apparently can not prevent this, not least because of the fact that Vietnam wants to enlist Soviet support against Pol Pot in pro-Chinese Cambodia.

changes.after: 1977年黎德寿赴莫斯科之后，越南与苏联的进一步靠拢开始了，前景是加入经互会，而他打算“日复一日”地加入。我们显然无法阻止这一点，至少因为越南希望争取苏联支持，以对付亲华柬埔寨境内的波尔布特。

changes.location: display:Comrade Chairman! In connection with the current situation in the international arena, a number of party members propose to organize their alternative to the Soviet economic alliance - the CMEA and the European - the EEC to continue the policy of expanding our influence and deepen trade and economic ties between the countries loyal to Beijing. However, some members of the Politburo consider this step too hasty, radical and thoughtless and suggest that this matter be postponed until better times. Although perhaps the best option would be to forget all the strife with the Soviet Union and join the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance?
changes.en: Comrade Chairman! In connection with the current situation in the international arena, a number of party members propose to organize their alternative to the Soviet economic alliance - the CMEA and the European - the EEC to continue the policy of expanding our influence and deepen trade and economic ties between the countries loyal to Beijing. However, some members of the Politburo consider this step too hasty, radical and thoughtless and suggest that this matter be postponed until better times. Although perhaps the best option would be to forget all the strife with the Soviet Union and join the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance?
changes.before: 同志主席！鉴于当前国际局势，若干党内成员提议组织我们自己的替代方案：对标苏联的经济联盟——经互会（经济互助委员会）以及欧洲的共同体（欧洲经济共同体），以继续扩大我们影响的政策，并加深与北京忠诚国家之间的贸易与经济联系。然而，政治局有些成员认为此举过于仓促、过于激进、也过于欠考虑，建议把这件事推迟到更好的时机。尽管也许最好的选择是忘掉同苏联的一切纷争，加入经互会？
changes.after: 同志主席！鉴于当前国际局势，若干党内成员提议组织我们自己的替代方案：对标苏联的经济联盟——经互会以及欧洲的共同体（欧洲经济共同体），以继续扩大我们影响的政策，并加深与北京忠诚国家之间的贸易与经济联系。然而，政治局有些成员认为此举过于仓促、过于激进、也过于欠考虑，建议把这件事推迟到更好的时机。尽管也许最好的选择是忘掉同苏联的一切纷争，加入经互会？

changes.location: display:Now that we have decided on a historical compromise and are granting special autonomy to Tibet with its own government, we should decide who will be recognized by us as the new spiritual and political leader of Tibet. Thus, we have three possible candidates for this post, since only three of them correspond to all religious canons: Panchen Lama X, our religious Tibetan figure, who was subjected to prison persecution and then married a woman of Han origin. The fugitive Dalai Lama XIV, an old political dissident living in India, engaged in active political activity and has long been applying for this post. And the last option is the Soviet Hambo Lama, the spiritual leader of the Soviet Buddhists, an activist of the organization of the struggle for peace and the development of the Buddhist school. In the case of the first option, we have the least amount of risks, with the third option, we risk becoming dependent on the Soviet Union, and the most risky is the second option - despite the statements of the Dalai Lama that he stands only for autonomy, not separatism, he has long-standing contacts with our dissidents and American politicians. The choice is yours.
changes.en: Now that we have decided on a historical compromise and are granting special autonomy to Tibet with its own government, we should decide who will be recognized by us as the new spiritual and political leader of Tibet. Thus, we have three possible candidates for this post, since only three of them correspond to all religious canons: Panchen Lama X, our religious Tibetan figure, who was subjected to prison persecution and then married a woman of Han origin. The fugitive Dalai Lama XIV, an old political dissident living in India, engaged in active political activity and has long been applying for this post. And the last option is the Soviet Hambo Lama, the spiritual leader of the Soviet Buddhists, an activist of the organization of the struggle for peace and the development of the Buddhist school. In the case of the first option, we have the least amount of risks, with the third option, we risk becoming dependent on the Soviet Union, and the most risky is the second option - despite the statements of the Dalai Lama that he stands only for autonomy, not separatism, he has long-standing contacts with our dissidents and American politicians. The choice is yours.
changes.before: 既然我们已经决定了历史性的折衷，并给予西藏以拥有自己政府的特殊自治，我们就应该决定由我们来承认谁将成为西藏新的宗教与政治领袖。因此，我们有三个可能的候选人，因为只有他们三人符合全部宗教教规：班禅喇嘛X，我们的宗教藏族代表人物，他曾遭受监禁迫害，随后与一位汉族女子结婚。逃亡的达赖喇嘛十四，居住在印度的老牌政治异议人士，积极从事政治活动，并长期申请担任这一职位。最后一个选项是苏联“汉博喇嘛”，苏联佛教徒的宗教领袖，是“争取和平与佛教发展”组织的活动人士。就第一种选项而言，我们的风险最小；第三种选项，我们可能会对苏联产生依赖；最危险的是第二种选项——尽管达赖喇嘛声称他只主张自治而非分裂，但他长期与我们的异议人士以及美国政界人士保持联系。选择权在你。

changes.location: display:Panchen Lama X previously received special support from the wives of Zhou Enlai and Deng Xiaoping, in particular, they saw an excellent political opportunity in creating a marriage of a Tibetan Lama with a Han girl. changes.en: Obviously, not everything in our country is perfect, and many people are dissatisfied with the party policy. Of course, the people are incited by revisionists and foreign agents, but maybe this is our chance to change the power structure a little? changes.location: display:After heavy fighting on the Kosovo-Metochian Plain and in Macedonia, the leadership of Yugoslavia, under pressure from the Warsaw Pact and NATO (fearing the expansion of the conflict and drawing superpowers into it), was forced to admit defeat and agree with Albanian claims to Kosovo, the Presovo Valley, the western communities of Macedonia and the southern communities Montenegro. The news of this led to thousands of demonstrations in Belgrade demanding «not to give up Kosovo», which were quickly joined by soldiers of the territorial defense and volunteer detachments returning from the front. Taking advantage of the situation, a group of high-ranking officials led by Hamdia Pozderats and Fikret Abdich, with the support of the JNA generals, carried out a coup d'état. A state of emergency was introduced, the entire old leadership of Yugoslavia was arrested, the country announced a break in the agreement with the CMEA, a rejection of the policy of non-alignment and applied to join the EEC, agreeing to a plan for large-scale market reforms. And the Albanian nationalists are celebrating the victory and looking at the Greek Northern Epirus...
changes.en: After heavy fighting on the Kosovo-Metochian Plain and in Macedonia, the leadership of Yugoslavia, under pressure from the Warsaw Pact and NATO (fearing the expansion of the conflict and drawing superpowers into it), was forced to admit defeat and agree with Albanian claims to Kosovo, the Presovo Valley, the western communities of Macedonia and the southern communities Montenegro. The news of this led to thousands of demonstrations in Belgrade demanding «not to give up Kosovo», which were quickly joined by soldiers of the territorial defense and volunteer detachments returning from the front. Taking advantage of the situation, a group of high-ranking officials led by Hamdia Pozderats and Fikret Abdich, with the support of the JNA generals, carried out a coup d'état. A state of emergency was introduced, the entire old leadership of Yugoslavia was arrested, the country announced a break in the agreement with the CMEA, a rejection of the policy of non-alignment and applied to join the EEC, agreeing to a plan for large-scale market reforms. And the Albanian nationalists are celebrating the victory and looking at the Greek Northern Epirus...

changes.location: display:{0}The defeat of Yugoslavia in the Kosovo War was a strong blow to the country and provoked a severe political crisis, but the new leadership, with the support of the JNA generals, was able to retain power by force and suppress the speeches of Slovenian and Croatian separatists. Throughout the 80s and 90s, large-scale reforms were carried out in the SFRY: there was a departure from Titoism and partial liberalization in politics (a limited multi-party system was allowed while maintaining the leading role of the SKJ, transformed into a Eurocommunist party, some of the Chetniks and even some Ustashe and Bosniak nationalists were rehabilitated, the system of councils and assemblies was simplified), the economy underwent a transition to a regulated market economy with the privatization of enterprises by their employees. This initially caused significant social problems, but then allowed to pay off the external debt and resume economic growth. At the same time, the influence of the Muslim Bosniaks noticeably increased in the renewed federation: under the Pozderats-Abdić duumvirate, they occupied over 60% of the leading positions, which causes deaf discontent of other peoples. In foreign policy, the SFRY is deepening cooperation with the EEC (which it was finally admitted to in 1995) and the Arab world, while refusing to recognize territorial changes and periodically threatening Albania with either sanctions or the threat of war.

changes.before: {0}科索沃战争中南斯拉夫的失败给该国造成了沉重打击，并引发严重的政治危机；但在南斯拉夫人民军（南斯拉夫人民军）将军的支持下，新领导层得以凭借武力保住政权，并压制斯洛文尼亚与克罗地亚分离主义者的发声。整个80年代与90年代，南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国（南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国）进行了大规模改革：从铁托主义转向，并在政治上进行部分自由化（在保持南斯拉夫共产主义者联盟主导地位的同时，允许有限的多党制；南斯拉夫共产主义者联盟被改造成欧洲共产主义政党；部分切特尼克甚至一些乌斯塔沙与波斯尼亚克民族主义者获得平反；委员会与议会制度被简化）。经济方面则转向受监管的市场经济，并由员工对企业进行私有化。起初这引发了显著的社会问题，但随后使外债得以偿还，并恢复经济增长。与此同时，在重建后的联邦中，穆斯林波斯尼亚克的影响力明显上升：在波兹德拉茨-阿卜迪奇二人执政（波兹德拉茨—阿布迪ć）之下，他们占据了超过60%的关键职位，这引来其他民族的强烈不满。在外交政策上，南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国深化与欧洲经济共同体（欧洲经济共同体）的合作（其最终于1995年被正式接纳），并加强与阿拉伯世界的联系，同时拒绝承认领土变更，并定期以制裁或战争威胁阿尔巴尼亚。

changes.location: display:Germany continued to exist as a confederal state. At first, different currencies were in circulation, and even duties were introduced on goods in order to balance the competitiveness of industries. After the start of reforms in the Soviet Union, Erich Honecker resigned and handed over the leadership of the party to Hans Modrow, who became the architect of the reforms. changes.location: display:Vietnamese troops, supported by units of the United Front for National Salvation of Kampuchea, easily defeated the Kampuchean army and occupied Phnom Penh. The Vietnamese, in agreement with the USSR, put Heng Samrin and Pen Sovan, former Khmer Rouge who had opposed Pol Pot and had been forced to emigrate, at the head of the new People's Republic of Kampuchea; now advocates of Soviet-style socialism, reforms along those lines were already underway, while a large Vietnamese military contingent remained in the country.{0}The new authorities are also preparing a tribunal against the old regime and collecting evidence of "the work of Pol Pot and his bloody clique for the US imperialists and Beijing revisionists". The remnants of the Khmer Rouge forces have retreated into the impenetrable jungle and to the border with Thailand, where they have turned to guerrilla warfare. It is known that negotiations are underway between PDFGNUK Khieu Sampfang (Khmer Rouge), General Son Sann's KPNLF (pro-US Republicans) and Prince Norodom Sihanouk's FUNSINPEC (monarchists) to establish a coalition government and unified military command. However, as long as Vietnam supports the PRC - they will not win.

changes.location: display:The difficult political and economic situation in the country led to the expansion of the popularity of the Naxalites, who, seeing an opportunity, in some century decided not to split, but to unite to take power around the "centrist" group of the "mass line". Naturally, this association will be such only until the power of the Naxalites in India is consolidated, but until then we can count on their power in the implementation of our plan. However, on paper, it looked successful: the united Naxalites raised uprisings in many Indian provinces, relying on the peasantry and backward distant tribes, announcing the seizure of power in these regions, to which the government tried to respond by suppressing self-capture by military forces. The Naxalites, who calculated to propagandize the military and send broad peasant-tribal masses to the cities, miscalculated: somewhere the masses achieved success and defeated the soldiers, and somewhere the military suppressed the rebels. A widespread civil war broke out all over India. There is nowhere else to retreat!

changes.location: display:With the support of our intelligence networks, we were able to rally all the trade union, democratic and left forces around the Peronist guerrillas and organize a single underground center in the jungle. The Coordinating Council of the opposition was not only able, with broad popular support, to save and protect many from illegal arrests, but also to organize strikes throughout the country, which completely stopped all production. In the conditions of fierce resistance within the junta, a coup took place: Roberto Eduardo Viola, with the support of Ramon Diaz, Orlando Ramon Agosti and a number of generals, arrested the leader of the junta Jorge Rafael Videla, Admiral Emilio Eduardo Masser and a number of their ardent associates, after which he announced an amnesty and entered into negotiations with the opposition within the framework of the round table. During the negotiations, a compromise was reached - the military abandoned the ban and persecution of trade unions and political parties, taking upon themselves the provision of order and stability in the country for an indefinite "period until the end of the crisis", thereby assuming the authority to Appoint the President, form the Cabinet of Ministers and set dates holding parliamentary elections. Despite the protests of the Peronist left, the democratic, left and trade union forces agreed to such an agreement, and the Peronist left had no choice but to agree to the demands for disarmament and the transition to peaceful actions, so as not to escalate the situation, but in response they demanded arrest and persecution AAA organizations and their chief Jose Lopez Rega himself, and the junta agreed to this. In Argentina, peace and order were restored, repression was stopped, and the Ministry of Economy was headed by General Ramon Diaz, who began the implementation of a policy of corporatism while maintaining state control over key industries. But the junta is well aware that their rule is not eternal, but will drag on to the last...

changes.before: 在我们的情报网络支持下，我们得以动员所有工会、民主派和左翼力量，围绕庇隆主义游击队集结，并在丛林中组织起一个统一的地下中心。反对派协调委员会不仅在广泛的群众支持下，成功拯救并保护了许多人免遭非法逮捕，而且还组织了全国范围的罢工，使所有生产活动彻底停摆。在军政府内部遭遇激烈抵抗的条件下，发生了政变：罗伯托·爱德华多·维奥拉在拉蒙·迪亚斯、奥兰多·拉蒙·阿戈斯蒂以及若干将军的支持下，逮捕了军政府领导人豪尔赫·拉斐尔·维德拉、海军上将埃米利奥·爱德华多·马瑟以及他们的一批狂热同伙；随后他宣布大赦，并在圆桌会议框架内与反对派展开谈判。谈判期间达成妥协——军方放弃对工会和政治党的禁令与迫害，承担起在“危机结束前的无限期期间”内维护国家秩序与稳定的责任，从而掌握任命总统、组建部长内阁并确定举行议会选举日期的权力。尽管庇隆主义左翼提出抗议，民主派、左翼和工会力量仍同意这一协议；庇隆主义左翼别无选择，只能同意解除武装以及转向和平行动的要求，以免局势升级，但作为回应，他们要求逮捕并迫害阿根廷反共联盟组织及其首脑何塞·洛佩斯·雷加本人，而军政府也同意了这一点。在阿根廷，和平与秩序得以恢复，镇压被停止，经济部由拉蒙·迪亚斯将军出任，他在保持对关键工业的国家控制的同时，开始推行公司主义政策。但军政府很清楚，他们的统治并非永恒，而是会拖到最后……

changes.location: display:The era of the National Front began in 1958 when the Liberal leader and the Conservative leader wrote the Benidorm Pact, which led to a 16-year era in which Liberals and Conservatives alternated as President every four years and also divided the Parliament equally, thus , in fact, having formed a liberal-conservative two-party dictatorship. The front arose as a consequence of civil wars between liberals and conservatives between 1948 and 1958 and served the purpose of reconciliation and stabilization in the country. While the National Front reduced violence and helped raise the GDP, it led to a stalemate between the two parties. The Liberal and Conservative parties held nearly equal power in both houses of Congress and were unable to push for major reforms with a two-thirds majority, as securing bipartisan support for policies was nearly impossible. This inability to reform gave rise to intra-party factionalism, which manifested itself in the creation of party social movements. The growth of dissident groups opposing the National Front led to the disintegration of the latter and the holding of real popular free elections. The main current candidates are Julio Cesar Turbay Ayala, for the Liberals, and Belisario Betancourt Cuartas for the Conservatives. However, if the rest of the opposition parties can really unite with each other in the National Opposition Union, then they will have a chance to turn Colombia finally into a democratic country.

changes.location: display:Jose Rangel, a well-known journalist and TV presenter, was elected president not by some "leftist coalition", but by the fact that all leftist parties supported his candidacy. This meant that in parliament Rangel had to form a "blue-red coalition" of the moderately left anti-imperialists MEP, the centre-left MAS and the economically moderate left but socio-politically conservative COPEI. The new government focused on further democratization and liberalization of the political, legal and judicial system, as well as strengthening antitrust laws, in particular in the media and radio and television broadcasting. The sudden drop in oil prices led to an economic crisis in Venezuela, which caused the coalition to collapse: COPEI demanded cooperation with the IMF and partial liberalization, while MEP and MAS offered IBEC under the CMEA, taking loans from socialist countries and developing internal trade in Latin America. This led to the formation of a government led by an obscure left-wing retired officer, Francisco Cárdenas, who began to form a government from the MBR-200 underground officers' circle. The people called this government "the first military." Despite fears of possible radicalism, the military coup did not happen, only "extraordinary economic measures" were introduced - for a period of 200 days, the government took personal control of the monopoly on foreign trade, thereby stabilizing the country's trade and currency balance. Despite the temporary deadline, this led to multiple protests from liberals and conservatives, after which José Rangel promised that he would no longer run for president, stating that politics was not for him and he wanted to return to journalism.

changes.before: 何塞·兰赫尔是一位知名记者与电视主持人，他当选总统并不是因为某种“左翼联盟”，而是因为所有左翼政党都支持他的候选资格。这意味着在议会中，兰赫尔必须组建一个“蓝-红联合”：由温和左翼的反帝国主义者人民选举运动、中间偏左的争取社会主义运动，以及在经济上较为温和的左翼但在社会政治上保守的独立选举政治组织委员会组成。新政府将重点放在进一步民主化与自由化政治、法律与司法体系，并加强反垄断法，尤其是在媒体与广播电视领域。石油价格的突然下跌引发委内瑞拉的经济危机，导致联合瓦解：独立选举政治组织委员会要求与国际货币基金组织合作并进行部分自由化，而人民选举运动与争取社会主义运动则提出在经济互助委员会框架下提供国际经济合作银行支持，从社会主义国家取得贷款，并发展拉丁美洲的内部贸易。于是，出现了由一位不太显眼的左翼退役军官弗朗西斯科·卡德纳斯（弗朗西斯科 卡德纳斯）领导的政府，他开始从玻利瓦尔革命运动二百地下军官圈子中组建政府。民众称这个政府为“第一支军政府”。尽管人们担心可能出现激进化，但并未发生军事政变；只是引入了«非常时期的经济措施»——在200天的期限内，政府亲自掌控对外贸易垄断，从而稳定了国家的贸易与货币收支。尽管只是暂时期限，但仍引发自由派与保守派的多次抗议；之后，何塞·兰赫尔承诺不再竞选总统，表示政治不适合他，他想回到新闻业。

changes.location: display:Kosolapov felt betrayed on all sides and then Chinese intelligence through the Chinese embassy stepped in. China arranged a meeting between Richard Kosolapov, Defence Minister Sergei Sokolov and Chief of the General Staff Sergei Akhromeev. During the negotiations, the Chinese representatives and Kosolapov himself convinced the military that because of Pechenyov and Pribytkov's dastardly stab in the back, the situation in the country was out of control and the Soviet Union was on the verge of its demise. Eventually, with the support of the army, an emergency Congress of the CPSU was organised, where mostly Kosolapov loyalists from all over the country were brought in, and at which Kosolapov was re-elected General Secretary, Pechenev and Pribytkov were expelled from the CPSU, and the Politburo was filled with the "young Stalinist" Viktor Anpilov, the odious writer Vladimir Bushin, the anti-Brezhnevist philosopher Mikhail Popov and the editor of Sovetskaya Rossia Valentin Chikin. The CPSU was purged of "revisionists, bureaucrats, and opportunists," its membership was reduced from 7 million to 2 million, and its membership criteria were tightened. Then, while the Supreme Soviet was still unable to elect a new Council of Ministers, armed forces were brought into all the major cities and the Interior Ministry cordoned off all squares and centres. Television broadcast speeches by the newly appointed members of the CPSU Central Committee Politburo, whose addresses generally summed up in one thought: "counter-revolutionary and reactionary forces took advantage of the restoration of Soviet democracy", "it was all a CIA plan to realise fascism for export to the USSR" and "keep calm, loyal Stalinists and supporters of genuine Soviet democracy will restore order". The Supreme Soviet was isolated, deputies were arrested, and re-elections were announced. A wave of arrests swept through the country, the laws against anti-Sovietism were tightened, and only candidates who had passed the state examinations on dialectics, the basic theses of MELS and political economy were allowed to take part in the new elections. Thus democracy was "curbed" and the new government adopted a programme of "10 new Stalin's blows": the restoration of self-government of enterprises within the goal of the implementation of planned quotas and state requirements like it was in the Stalin model; the return of monuments and names of Stalin (including the return of the name of Stalingrad to Volgograd); reversal of Khrushchev's rehabilitation of the repressed; organisation of the transfer of power to the Stalinist forces in the socialist countries; creation of a unified CMEA economy; dissolution of the Warsaw Pact organisation with the re-establishment of Cominform; complete break with the Eurocommunist movements; development of a new stage in the development of Marxist theory within the framework of the "Kosolapov-Popov concept"; legalisation and expansion of the rights of artels, small businesses and rentiers; as well as the rejection of the "Policy of Coexistence" and "Détente" and the transition to an active struggle against world Social-Fascism. {0}It is interesting that everything that is happening allowed the newspaper "Literaturnaya Rossiya" to publish an interview of Felix Chuev with the old Stalinist Lazar Kaganovich, which ended with the following expression of his: "Workers, Communists, are you completely blind or something? Where are Stalin's ideas here? You should be shot for such a thing! This is a catastrophe."

changes.before: 科索拉波夫在各方面都感到被背叛，随后中国情报机构通过中国驻外使馆介入。中国安排了一次会面：理查德·科索拉波夫、国防部长谢尔盖·索科洛夫以及总参谋长谢尔盖·阿赫罗梅耶夫。谈判期间，中国代表以及科索拉波夫本人说服军方：由于佩切涅夫与普里比特科夫的卑劣背刺，国内局势已经失控，苏联正濒临崩溃。最终，在军队支持下，组织了苏共的紧急代表大会；来自全国各地的多为科索拉波夫忠诚者被带入会场。在会上，科索拉波夫被重新选为总书记；佩切涅夫与普里比特科夫被开除出苏共；政治局则被填入“年轻斯大林主义者”维克托尔·安皮洛夫、令人厌恶的作家弗拉基米尔·布申、反勃列日涅夫主义的哲学家米哈伊尔·波波夫，以及《苏维埃俄罗斯报》的编辑瓦连京·奇金。苏共被清洗“修正主义者、官僚与机会主义者”，党员人数从700万降至200万，并收紧了入党标准。随后，当最高苏维埃仍无法选出新的部长会议时，武装力量被部署到所有主要城市，内务部封锁了所有广场与中心地带。电视转播了新任命的苏共中央委员会政治局成员的讲话，他们的发言大多汇成一个想法：“反革命与反动势力趁机恢复了苏联的苏维埃民主”；“这全是中央情报局（中央情报局）的计划，要把法西斯输出到苏联”；以及“保持冷静，忠诚的斯大林主义者与真正苏联民主的支持者将恢复秩序”。最高苏维埃被隔离，议员被逮捕，并宣布重新选举。一波逮捕浪潮席卷全国，针对反苏主义的法律被进一步收紧；只有通过国家关于辩证法、马恩列斯思想基本论点与政治经济学国家考试的候选人，才被允许参加新的选举。于是，民主被“压制”，新政府采纳了“10记新的斯大林重拳”的方案：在实现计划配额与国家要求的目标下，恢复企业的自治权——就像斯大林模式那样；恢复斯大林的纪念碑与名字（包括将斯大林格勒的名称恢复到伏尔加格勒）；推翻赫鲁晓夫对被镇压者的平反；组织将政权移交给社会主义国家中的斯大林主义力量；建立统一的经互会（经济互助委员会）经济；解散华沙条约组织并重建共产党情报局（共产党和工人党情报局）；与欧洲共产主义运动彻底决裂；在“科索拉波夫-波波夫构想”的框架内发展马克思主义理论的新阶段；对手工业合作社、小企业与租佃者的权利进行合法化并扩大；以及拒绝“共存政策”和“缓和政策”，并转向对世界社会法西斯的积极斗争。{0}有趣的是，正在发生的一切让报纸《文学俄罗斯》得以刊登费利克斯·丘耶夫对老斯大林主义者拉扎尔·卡冈诺维奇的采访，采访以他这段话收尾：“蠢货们！你们到底为什么要诽谤斯大林？！当年有斯大林——有一个理念；可现在看来，在斯大林的理念之下，宗教和私人资本都一起出现了！”

changes.location: display:The one who persuaded Emperor Hirohito to abdicate after another defeat was his brother Mikasa-no-miya Takahito, who also recommended changing the law of succession and passing the throne to a new branch of the imperial family not tainted by constant defeats, namely Hirohito's nephew Takamado-no-miya Norihito. Having come to power and received support from China, the new emperor actively engaged in eradicating corruption and mafia in the country. Many politicians were imprisoned, many members of the mafia were killed in numerous ‘Clean Hands’ operations, and the property seized from corporations was divided into parts and privatised into the hands of various owners.|As a result, through the force of violence and the support of China, Japan experienced a new flowering of democracy, freedoms and human rights, finally cleansed of mafia structures in the government and economy. However, their place was taken by Chinese ‘friends’, agents and entrepreneurs, marking Japan's transition not only to a true liberal democracy, but also to a unity in a new federation with Beijing.

However, their place was taken by Chinese ‘friends’, agents and entrepreneurs, marking Japan's transition not only to a true liberal democracy, but also to a unity in a new federation with Beijing.

changes.location: display:The Khmer Rouge came to power in 1975 and have since become China's active allies in the struggle for dominance in Southeast Asia. It was only a year after the regime was established, but the ruling party itself had already split. Two groups with different views on further reforms in Kampuchea have emerged in the leading core: the left wing, consisting of Hu Nim, Hou Yuon and Khieu Samphan, opposes the ideas of the central wing, led by Pol Pot, Nuon Chea and Son Sen, which consist in total collectivisation of all spheres in the country and dividing it into communes. At the moment, the political struggle has entered an active phase and the next month will be decisive in the confrontation between the two factions. However, maybe we should take advantage of this strife and destroy this point of instability in the region with the help of our brave liberation army...?

changes.before: 红色高棉于1975年上台，此后成为中国在争夺东南亚主导权斗争中的积极盟友。政权建立仅仅一年后，执政党本身就已经分裂。围绕柬埔寨后续改革的进一步路线，领导核心中出现了两派观点不同的集团：左翼由胡宁（Hu 宁）、侯宥恩（侯 宥恩）与凯修·桑潘（乔 森潘）组成，反对由波尔布特（波尔布特）、农诺切亚（农谢）与宋森（山 森）领导的中央翼；中央翼主张对国家所有领域进行彻底集体化，并将其划分为公社。此刻，政治斗争已进入活跃阶段，下个月两派对峙将决定胜负。然而，也许我们应该利用这场内斗，在勇敢的解放军帮助下摧毁这一区域的不稳定源头……？

changes.location: display:In the course of the political struggle Pol Pot decided to implement a cunning and remove the main blow from himself by announcing his ‘illness’, however, under our pressure from 7 September 1976, within a month, Khieu Samphan, the most agreementable of the left wing, was appointed interim Prime Minister of Kampuchea. Having realised whose side the full might of China stood behind, Khieu remained loyal to the left wing of the party and, with its support, Pol Pot was isolated and sent for indefinite ‘treatment’. In October, the centre wing was finally defeated and left wing leader Hu Nim became General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Kampuchea. A party-led planned economy was established in the cities, while in the countryside independent co-operatives were formed, operating on the market principle, ‘as Kampuchea had only recently been a feudal country and was not yet ready for full socialism’. Private property, however, had already been abolished.

changes.before: 在政治斗争过程中，波尔布特决定耍一个狡猾的手段：通过宣布“生病”来移开主要打击。然而在我们对他施压的1976年9月7日之后，仅仅一个月内，左翼中最容易达成一致的人凯修·桑潘被任命为柬埔寨临时首相。凯修意识到中国的全部力量站在谁那一边，于是他对党的左翼保持忠诚，并在其支持下，波尔布特被孤立并被送去接受“无限期治疗”。10月时，中央翼终于被击败，左翼领袖胡宁（Hu 宁）成为柬埔寨共产党中央委员会总书记。城市里建立了由党领导的计划经济；而在乡村则成立独立合作社，按市场原则运作，理由是“柬埔寨只是最近才成为封建国家，尚未准备好全面社会主义”。然而，私有财产早已被废除。

changes.location: display:To circumvent the Western European blockade, Rigler decided to build bridges with Hungary, in particular with one of its prominent figures, Imre Pozsgay. In the course of negotiations, the two politicians drew up a diplomatic project for the creation of a partnership between Austria and Hungary, which, with the mediation of Otto von Habsburg, evolved into the ‘Pan-European Picnic’ organisation. The aim of the new organisation is to jointly counteract international pressure on the basis of the historical legacy of friendship between Hungarians and Austrians. Formally, the organisation did not violate the programmes of either the COMECON nor the Warsaw Pact, so, despite protests from the USSR, the Hungarian parliament (and later the Austrian parliament) ratified this agreement, beginning an era of a new joint diplomatic, cultural and trade partnership.

changes.before: 为了绕过西欧封锁，里格勒决定与匈牙利搭桥，尤其是与其一位颇具影响力的人物伊姆雷·波兹加伊（伊姆雷·波日高伊）。在谈判过程中，两位政客拟定了一个外交项目：建立奥地利与匈牙利之间的伙伴关系，并在奥托·冯·哈布斯堡（奥托 冯 哈布斯堡）的斡旋下，逐步演变为“泛欧洲野餐”（泛欧洲 野餐）组织。新组织的目标，是在以匈牙利人与奥地利人之间的历史友谊遗产为基础的前提下，共同抵御国际压力。形式上，该组织并未违反经互会（经互会）或华沙条约的任何项目，因此尽管苏联提出抗议，匈牙利议会（随后是奥地利议会）仍批准了这一协议，开启了一个新的共同外交、文化与贸易伙伴关系时代。

changes.location: display:In the never-ending confrontation with sanctions, Austria continued to drift further and further away from Western Europe. The Social Democratic Party gradually lost its former influence and was replaced by the Austrian People's Party, which firmly took over the left-wing social and green agenda from the Social Democrats, thus becoming culturally right-wing but socially and economically left-wing. The Austrian Freedom Party took over the right-wing economic spectrum, advocating protectionism, keeping foreign enterprises out of the economy, rejecting immigration, supporting a flat tax scale and fighting speculation on currency and other speculations. With the change of the electoral system from proportional to majoritarian, the Social Democrats were finally defeated in the elections and split into left-wing liberals led by Viktor Klima and democratic socialists led by Jörg Leichtfried. Austria eventually became an associate member of the COMECON and an observer of many Asian and Arab organisations, becoming the main bastion of right-wing Euroscepticism in Europe.

changes.before: 在与制裁这场永无止境的对抗中，奥地利继续越走越远离西欧。社会民主党逐渐失去昔日影响力，被奥地利人民党取代。人民党牢牢接过社会民主党留下的左翼社会与绿色议程——因此在文化上偏右翼，但在社会与经济上偏左翼。奥地利自由党则接管了右翼经济光谱，主张保护主义、将外国企业排除在经济之外、拒绝移民、支持统一所得税税率，并与货币投机及其他投机行为作斗争。随着选举制度从比例代表制改为多数代表制，社会民主党在选举中最终被击败，并分裂为以维克托·克拉伊纳（维克托 克利马）为首的左翼自由派，以及以约尔格·莱希特弗里德（约尔格 莱希特弗里德）为首的民主社会主义者。奥地利最终成为经互会（经互会）的准成员，并成为许多亚洲与阿拉伯组织的观察员，成为欧洲右翼欧洲怀疑主义的主要堡垒。

changes.location: display:After a series of personnel changes, the Congress of the Central Committee of the Hungarian Socialist Party officially adopted a pragmatic version of the "Gábor Bethlen Programme" as the official programme for the coming five-year period. The project envisages cautious economic reforms and a transition to a revival of Hungarian national consciousness within the framework of a "Marxist realisation of the national question". Despite Moscow's guarded protests on the sidelines, Pozhgai reaffirmed Hungary's membership in CMEA and the OVD and even promised Moscow an end to its policy of endless borrowing from the Western powers.

changes.before: 在一系列人事变动之后，匈牙利社会主义党中央委员会代表大会正式通过了“加博尔·贝特伦计划”的务实版本，作为未来五年的官方纲领。该项目设想谨慎的经济改革，并在“以马克思主义实现民族问题”的框架内，向匈牙利民族意识复兴过渡。尽管莫斯科在旁侧提出谨慎的抗议，波兹加伊仍重申匈牙利加入经互会（经济互助委员会）与华沙条约组织（华沙条约组织），甚至还向莫斯科承诺：结束其从西方强权那里进行无休止借贷的政策。

changes.location: display:Attempts by Hungary and Austria to start the process of merger, and even more so under a new king, caused serious misgivings from Moscow. Attempts at behind-the-scenes negotiations between Budapest and Moscow failed, and there were no mediators acceptable to both sides. As a result, when the Hungarian authorities openly announced their intention to ratify in the near future the treaty on unification into a confederation with Austria under the single crown of the yet-to-be-elected monarch, Moscow again brought in the tanks. Strangely enough, some of the comrades of the "new Imre Nadja" also defected to the side of the Soviet Union, namely the entire foursome of the reform group co-opted by Pozhgai. There was no resistance and, as a result, Požgai and the entire leadership of the ruling Party were arrested and power passed into the hands of the government formed under the leadership of Borbey. The country tightened censorship and the rights of the law enforcement agencies, re-established the special services, the economy switched back to a planned economy with financial support from Moscow, but in the socio-political sphere nationalist propaganda was launched to pacify the masses. The VSRP was reorganised into the Hungarian Workers' and Peasants' Party and the symbols of the state were returned to the attributes of the Hungarian kingdom, but without the crown and monarchical regalia.|At the same time, practically none of the socialist and communist parties of the world condemned the Soviet troops this time, believing that the reactionary attempt to restore the monarchy and the Austro-Hungarian imperialist experiment was a far more terrible event than another Soviet intervention.

The country tightened censorship and the rights of the law enforcement agencies, re-established the special services, the economy switched back to a planned economy with financial support from Moscow, but in the socio-political sphere nationalist propaganda was launched to pacify the masses. The VSRP was reorganised into the Hungarian Workers' and Peasants' Party and the symbols of the state were returned to the attributes of the Hungarian kingdom, but without the crown and monarchical regalia.|At the same time, practically none of the socialist and communist parties of the world condemned the Soviet troops this time, believing that the reactionary attempt to restore the monarchy and the Austro-Hungarian imperialist experiment was a far more terrible event than another Soviet intervention.
changes.before: 匈牙利与奥地利试图启动合并进程，尤其是在新国王的名义下进行，这引起了莫斯科的严重疑虑。布达佩斯与莫斯科之间的幕后谈判尝试失败了，双方都无法接受任何调停者。结果，当匈牙利当局公开宣布打算在不久的将来批准一项条约：在尚未选出的君主的单一王冠之下，与奥地利统一为邦联时，莫斯科再次出动坦克。更离奇的是，“新伊姆雷·纳贾”（新 伊姆雷 娜佳）的一些同志也叛逃到了苏联一边，也就是波兹加伊所拉拢的改革小组的整个四人组。没有任何抵抗，因此波兹加伊以及执政党的全部领导层被逮捕，政权转交给由博尔贝伊领导组建的政府。该国加强审查制度，收紧执法机构的权利，重新建立特务机关；经济则在莫斯科的财政支持下重新转回计划经济。但在社会政治领域，民族主义宣传被启动以安抚民众。匈牙利工人和劳动人民党（匈牙利社会主义工人党）被改组为匈牙利工人党与农民党，国家象征也被恢复到匈牙利王国的属性之中——但没有王冠与君主制礼仪。|与此同时，实际上世界上几乎没有任何社会主义与共产主义政党这次谴责苏联军队，认为这次反动的企图恢复君主制、重演奥匈帝国的帝国主义实验，比另一场苏联干预更可怕。

changes.en: Thanks to the active work of our intelligence networks with far-right movements in Turkey, we managed to "correct" all the flaws in the program of National Movement Party and Gray Wolves, thereby, to allow it to collude with the junta by getting its representatives into the government.{0}By joint efforts, they expanded the persecution of communists, democrats, left-wing writers and dissidents, representatives of national minorities - "death camps" were created throughout the country, and extrajudicial killings and "black lists" have become common practice.{0}The world community has generally condemned the military coup.
changes.before: 多亏了我们情报网络与土耳其的极右翼运动积极开展工作，我们得以“纠正”民族运动党和灰狼的所有项目缺陷，从而让它通过把代表安插进政府来与政变集团勾结。{0}通过共同努力，他们扩大了对共产主义者、民主派、左翼作家和异议人士，以及少数民族代表的迫害——全国各地建立了“死亡营”，并且越轨处决和“黑名单”已成为常态。{0}国际社会普遍谴责军事政变。
changes.after: 多亏了我们特工网络与土耳其的极右翼运动积极开展工作，我们得以“纠正”民族运动党和灰狼的所有项目缺陷，从而让它通过把代表安插进政府来与政变集团勾结。{0}通过共同努力，他们扩大了对共产主义者、民主派、左翼作家和异议人士，以及少数民族代表的迫害——全国各地建立了“死亡营”，并且越轨处决和“黑名单”已成为常态。{0}国际社会普遍谴责军事政变。

changes.en: The difficult political and economic situation in the country led to the expansion of the popularity of the Naxalites, who, seeing an opportunity, in some century decided not to split, but to unite to take power around the "centrist" group of the "mass line". Naturally, this association will be such only until the power of the Naxalites in India is consolidated, but until then we can count on their power in the implementation of our plan. However, on paper, it looked successful: the united Naxalites raised uprisings in many Indian provinces, relying on the peasantry and backward distant tribes, announcing the seizure of power in these regions, to which the government tried to respond by suppressing self-capture by military forces. The Naxalites, who calculated to propagandize the military and send broad peasant-tribal masses to the cities, miscalculated: somewhere the masses achieved success and defeated the soldiers, and somewhere the military suppressed the rebels. A widespread civil war broke out all over India. There is nowhere else to retreat!
changes.before: 该国艰难的政治与经济局势导致纳萨尔派的声望扩张：他们看到了机会，在某个世纪里决定不再分裂，而是团结起来，围绕“群众路线”的“中间派”集团夺取政权。当然，这种结盟只会在印度纳萨尔派的力量尚未巩固之前才成立；但在那之前，我们可以指望他们的力量来执行我们的计划。然而从纸面上看，一切似乎很成功：联合起来的纳萨尔派在印度许多省份发动起义，依靠农民与落后的偏远部落，宣布夺取这些地区的政权；政府则试图用军队力量镇压“自我占领”。纳萨尔派原本打算宣传并动员广大的农民-部落群众涌向城市，结果算错了：在某些地方，群众取得了成功并击败了士兵；在另一些地方，军队镇压了叛乱者。整个印度爆发了广泛的内战。没有退路！

changes.en: With the support of our intelligence networks, we were able to rally all the trade union, democratic and left forces around the Peronist guerrillas and organize a single underground center in the jungle. The Coordinating Council of the opposition was not only able, with broad popular support, to save and protect many from illegal arrests, but also to organize strikes throughout the country, which completely stopped all production. In the conditions of fierce resistance within the junta, a coup took place: Roberto Eduardo Viola, with the support of Ramon Diaz, Orlando Ramon Agosti and a number of generals, arrested the leader of the junta Jorge Rafael Videla, Admiral Emilio Eduardo Masser and a number of their ardent associates, after which he announced an amnesty and entered into negotiations with the opposition within the framework of the round table. During the negotiations, a compromise was reached - the military abandoned the ban and persecution of trade unions and political parties, taking upon themselves the provision of order and stability in the country for an indefinite "period until the end of the crisis", thereby assuming the authority to Appoint the President, form the Cabinet of Ministers and set dates holding parliamentary elections. Despite the protests of the Peronist left, the democratic, left and trade union forces agreed to such an agreement, and the Peronist left had no choice but to agree to the demands for disarmament and the transition to peaceful actions, so as not to escalate the situation, but in response they demanded arrest and persecution AAA organizations and their chief Jose Lopez Rega himself, and the junta agreed to this. In Argentina, peace and order were restored, repression was stopped, and the Ministry of Economy was headed by General Ramon Diaz, who began the implementation of a policy of corporatism while maintaining state control over key industries. But the junta is well aware that their rule is not eternal, but will drag on to the last...
changes.before: 在我们的情报网络支持下，我们得以动员所有工会、民主派和左翼力量，围绕庇隆主义游击队集结，并在丛林中组织起一个统一的地下中心。反对派协调委员会不仅在广泛的群众支持下，成功拯救并保护了许多人免遭非法逮捕，而且还组织了全国范围的罢工，使所有生产活动彻底停摆。在军政府内部遭遇激烈抵抗的条件下，发生了政变：罗伯托·爱德华多·维奥拉在拉蒙·迪亚斯、奥兰多·拉蒙·阿戈斯蒂以及若干将军的支持下，逮捕了军政府领导人豪尔赫·拉斐尔·维德拉、海军上将埃米利奥·爱德华多·马瑟以及他们的一批狂热同伙；随后他宣布大赦，并在圆桌会议框架内与反对派展开谈判。谈判期间达成妥协——军方放弃对工会和政治党的禁令与迫害，承担起在“危机结束前的无限期期间”内维护国家秩序与稳定的责任，从而掌握任命总统、组建部长内阁并确定举行议会选举日期的权力。尽管庇隆主义左翼提出抗议，民主派、左翼和工会力量仍同意这一协议；庇隆主义左翼别无选择，只能同意解除武装以及转向和平行动的要求，以免局势升级，但作为回应，他们要求逮捕并迫害阿根廷反共联盟组织及其首脑何塞·洛佩斯·雷加本人，而军政府也同意了这一点。在阿根廷，和平与秩序得以恢复，镇压被停止，经济部由拉蒙·迪亚斯将军出任，他在保持对关键工业的国家控制的同时，开始推行公司主义政策。但军政府很清楚，他们的统治并非永恒，而是会拖到最后……

changes.en: The era of the National Front began in 1958 when the Liberal leader and the Conservative leader wrote the Benidorm Pact, which led to a 16-year era in which Liberals and Conservatives alternated as President every four years and also divided the Parliament equally, thus , in fact, having formed a liberal-conservative two-party dictatorship. The front arose as a consequence of civil wars between liberals and conservatives between 1948 and 1958 and served the purpose of reconciliation and stabilization in the country. While the National Front reduced violence and helped raise the GDP, it led to a stalemate between the two parties. The Liberal and Conservative parties held nearly equal power in both houses of Congress and were unable to push for major reforms with a two-thirds majority, as securing bipartisan support for policies was nearly impossible. This inability to reform gave rise to intra-party factionalism, which manifested itself in the creation of party social movements. The growth of dissident groups opposing the National Front led to the disintegration of the latter and the holding of real popular free elections. The main current candidates are Julio Cesar Turbay Ayala, for the Liberals, and Belisario Betancourt Cuartas for the Conservatives. However, if the rest of the opposition parties can really unite with each other in the National Opposition Union, then they will have a chance to turn Colombia finally into a democratic country.
changes.before: 1958年，民族阵线的时代开始：自由派领袖与保守派领袖签署了《贝尼多姆协议（贝尼多姆 协议）》，从而开启了长达16年的时期——自由派与保守派每四年轮流由一方担任总统，并且议会席位也被平均分配；因此，实际上形成了自由-保守的两党独裁。民族阵线的出现源于1948至1958年间自由派与保守派之间的内战，其目的在于实现国家和解与稳定。民族阵线虽然减少了暴力、并帮助提高国内生产总值（国内生产总值），但也导致两党之间陷入僵局。自由党与保守党在国会两院拥有近乎相等的权力，且由于难以获得三分之二多数的跨党派支持，无法推动重大改革。无法改革使党内派系主义滋生，并表现为建立党内社会运动。反对民族阵线的异议团体的壮大，导致后者瓦解，并举行真正的、由民众参与的自由选举。主要候选人是：自由派方面的胡利奥·塞萨尔·图尔拜·阿亚拉（胡利奥 塞萨尔 图尔瓦伊 阿亚拉），以及保守派方面的贝利萨里奥·贝坦库尔·夸尔塔斯（贝利萨里奥 贝坦库尔 夸尔塔斯）。不过，如果其他反对党真的能在“全国反对联盟”中彼此联合，那么他们就有机会最终把哥伦比亚变成一个民主国家。

changes.en: Jose Rangel, a well-known journalist and TV presenter, was elected president not by some "leftist coalition", but by the fact that all leftist parties supported his candidacy. This meant that in parliament Rangel had to form a "blue-red coalition" of the moderately left anti-imperialists MEP, the centre-left MAS and the economically moderate left but socio-politically conservative COPEI. The new government focused on further democratization and liberalization of the political, legal and judicial system, as well as strengthening antitrust laws, in particular in the media and radio and television broadcasting. The sudden drop in oil prices led to an economic crisis in Venezuela, which caused the coalition to collapse: COPEI demanded cooperation with the IMF and partial liberalization, while MEP and MAS offered IBEC under the CMEA, taking loans from socialist countries and developing internal trade in Latin America. This led to the formation of a government led by an obscure left-wing retired officer, Francisco Cárdenas, who began to form a government from the MBR-200 underground officers' circle. The people called this government "the first military." Despite fears of possible radicalism, the military coup did not happen, only "extraordinary economic measures" were introduced - for a period of 200 days, the government took personal control of the monopoly on foreign trade, thereby stabilizing the country's trade and currency balance. Despite the temporary deadline, this led to multiple protests from liberals and conservatives, after which José Rangel promised that he would no longer run for president, stating that politics was not for him and he wanted to return to journalism.
changes.before: 何塞·兰赫尔是一位知名记者与电视主持人，他当选总统并不是因为某种“左翼联盟”，而是因为所有左翼政党都支持他的候选资格。这意味着在议会中，兰赫尔必须组建一个“蓝-红联合”：由温和左翼的反帝国主义者人民选举运动、中间偏左的争取社会主义运动，以及在经济上较为温和的左翼但在社会政治上保守的独立选举政治组织委员会组成。新政府将重点放在进一步民主化与自由化政治、法律与司法体系，并加强反垄断法，尤其是在媒体与广播电视领域。石油价格的突然下跌引发委内瑞拉的经济危机，导致联合瓦解：独立选举政治组织委员会要求与国际货币基金组织合作并进行部分自由化，而人民选举运动与争取社会主义运动则提出在经济互助委员会框架下提供国际经济合作银行支持，从社会主义国家取得贷款，并发展拉丁美洲的内部贸易。于是，出现了由一位不太显眼的左翼退役军官弗朗西斯科·卡德纳斯（弗朗西斯科 卡德纳斯）领导的政府，他开始从玻利瓦尔革命运动二百地下军官圈子中组建政府。民众称这个政府为“第一支军政府”。尽管人们担心可能出现激进化，但并未发生军事政变；只是引入了«非常时期的经济措施»——在200天的期限内，政府亲自掌控对外贸易垄断，从而稳定了国家的贸易与货币收支。尽管只是暂时期限，但仍引发自由派与保守派的多次抗议；之后，何塞·兰赫尔承诺不再竞选总统，表示政治不适合他，他想回到新闻业。

changes.en: Kosolapov felt betrayed on all sides and then Chinese intelligence through the Chinese embassy stepped in. China arranged a meeting between Richard Kosolapov, Defence Minister Sergei Sokolov and Chief of the General Staff Sergei Akhromeev. During the negotiations, the Chinese representatives and Kosolapov himself convinced the military that because of Pechenyov and Pribytkov's dastardly stab in the back, the situation in the country was out of control and the Soviet Union was on the verge of its demise. Eventually, with the support of the army, an emergency Congress of the CPSU was organised, where mostly Kosolapov loyalists from all over the country were brought in, and at which Kosolapov was re-elected General Secretary, Pechenev and Pribytkov were expelled from the CPSU, and the Politburo was filled with the "young Stalinist" Viktor Anpilov, the odious writer Vladimir Bushin, the anti-Brezhnevist philosopher Mikhail Popov and the editor of Sovetskaya Rossia Valentin Chikin. The CPSU was purged of "revisionists, bureaucrats, and opportunists," its membership was reduced from 7 million to 2 million, and its membership criteria were tightened. Then, while the Supreme Soviet was still unable to elect a new Council of Ministers, armed forces were brought into all the major cities and the Interior Ministry cordoned off all squares and centres. Television broadcast speeches by the newly appointed members of the CPSU Central Committee Politburo, whose addresses generally summed up in one thought: "counter-revolutionary and reactionary forces took advantage of the restoration of Soviet democracy", "it was all a CIA plan to realise fascism for export to the USSR" and "keep calm, loyal Stalinists and supporters of genuine Soviet democracy will restore order". The Supreme Soviet was isolated, deputies were arrested, and re-elections were announced. A wave of arrests swept through the country, the laws against anti-Sovietism were tightened, and only candidates who had passed the state examinations on dialectics, the basic theses of MELS and political economy were allowed to take part in the new elections. Thus democracy was "curbed" and the new government adopted a programme of "10 new Stalin's blows": the restoration of self-government of enterprises within the goal of the implementation of planned quotas and state requirements like it was in the Stalin model; the return of monuments and names of Stalin (including the return of the name of Stalingrad to Volgograd); reversal of Khrushchev's rehabilitation of the repressed; organisation of the transfer of power to the Stalinist forces in the socialist countries; creation of a unified CMEA economy; dissolution of the Warsaw Pact organisation with the re-establishment of Cominform; complete break with the Eurocommunist movements; development of a new stage in the development of Marxist theory within the framework of the "Kosolapov-Popov concept"; legalisation and expansion of the rights of artels, small businesses and rentiers; as well as the rejection of the "Policy of Coexistence" and "Détente" and the transition to an active struggle against world Social-Fascism. {0}It is interesting that everything that is happening allowed the newspaper "Literaturnaya Rossiya" to publish an interview of Felix Chuev with the old Stalinist Lazar Kaganovich, which ended with the following expression of his: "Workers, Communists, are you completely blind or something? Where are Stalin's ideas here? You should be shot for such a thing! This is a catastrophe."
changes.before: 科索拉波夫在各方面都感到被背叛，随后中国情报机构通过中国驻外使馆介入。中国安排了一次会面：理查德·科索拉波夫、国防部长谢尔盖·索科洛夫以及总参谋长谢尔盖·阿赫罗梅耶夫。谈判期间，中国代表以及科索拉波夫本人说服军方：由于佩切涅夫与普里比特科夫的卑劣背刺，国内局势已经失控，苏联正濒临崩溃。最终，在军队支持下，组织了苏共的紧急代表大会；来自全国各地的多为科索拉波夫忠诚者被带入会场。在会上，科索拉波夫被重新选为总书记；佩切涅夫与普里比特科夫被开除出苏共；政治局则被填入“年轻斯大林主义者”维克托尔·安皮洛夫、令人厌恶的作家弗拉基米尔·布申、反勃列日涅夫主义的哲学家米哈伊尔·波波夫，以及《苏维埃俄罗斯报》的编辑瓦连京·奇金。苏共被清洗“修正主义者、官僚与机会主义者”，党员人数从700万降至200万，并收紧了入党标准。随后，当最高苏维埃仍无法选出新的部长会议时，武装力量被部署到所有主要城市，内务部封锁了所有广场与中心地带。电视转播了新任命的苏共中央委员会政治局成员的讲话，他们的发言大多汇成一个想法：“反革命与反动势力趁机恢复了苏联的苏维埃民主”；“这全是中央情报局（中央情报局）的计划，要把法西斯输出到苏联”；以及“保持冷静，忠诚的斯大林主义者与真正苏联民主的支持者将恢复秩序”。最高苏维埃被隔离，议员被逮捕，并宣布重新选举。一波逮捕浪潮席卷全国，针对反苏主义的法律被进一步收紧；只有通过国家关于辩证法、马恩列斯思想基本论点与政治经济学国家考试的候选人，才被允许参加新的选举。于是，民主被“压制”，新政府采纳了“10记新的斯大林重拳”的方案：在实现计划配额与国家要求的目标下，恢复企业的自治权——就像斯大林模式那样；恢复斯大林的纪念碑与名字（包括将斯大林格勒的名称恢复到伏尔加格勒）；推翻赫鲁晓夫对被镇压者的平反；组织将政权移交给社会主义国家中的斯大林主义力量；建立统一的经互会（经济互助委员会）经济；解散华沙条约组织并重建共产党情报局（共产党和工人党情报局）；与欧洲共产主义运动彻底决裂；在“科索拉波夫-波波夫构想”的框架内发展马克思主义理论的新阶段；对手工业合作社、小企业与租佃者的权利进行合法化并扩大；以及拒绝“共存政策”和“缓和政策”，并转向对世界社会法西斯的积极斗争。{0}有趣的是，正在发生的一切让报纸《文学俄罗斯》得以刊登费利克斯·丘耶夫对老斯大林主义者拉扎尔·卡冈诺维奇的采访，采访以他这段话收尾：“蠢货们！你们到底为什么要诽谤斯大林？！当年有斯大林——有一个理念；可现在看来，在斯大林的理念之下，宗教和私人资本都一起出现了！”

changes.en: The one who persuaded Emperor Hirohito to abdicate after another defeat was his brother Mikasa-no-miya Takahito, who also recommended changing the law of succession and passing the throne to a new branch of the imperial family not tainted by constant defeats, namely Hirohito's nephew Takamado-no-miya Norihito. Having come to power and received support from China, the new emperor actively engaged in eradicating corruption and mafia in the country. Many politicians were imprisoned, many members of the mafia were killed in numerous ‘Clean Hands’ operations, and the property seized from corporations was divided into parts and privatised into the hands of various owners.|As a result, through the force of violence and the support of China, Japan experienced a new flowering of democracy, freedoms and human rights, finally cleansed of mafia structures in the government and economy. However, their place was taken by Chinese ‘friends’, agents and entrepreneurs, marking Japan's transition not only to a true liberal democracy, but also to a unity in a new federation with Beijing.
changes.before: 在又一次惨败之后，是他的兄弟三笠宫高仁（三笠宫 崇仁）说服裕仁退位；他还建议修改继承法，把王位传给不再被持续惨败所玷污的皇室新分支——裕仁的侄子高正亲王（高圆宫 宪仁）。新皇帝在获得中国支持后上台，积极在国内清除腐败与黑帮。许多政治人物被监禁，许多黑帮成员在无数“清白之手”行动中被杀；从公司没收的财产被拆分并私有化，交给各类不同的所有者。|因此，在暴力强制与中国支持之下，日本迎来了民主、自由与人权的新繁荣，最终彻底清除政府与经济中的黑帮结构。然而，黑帮的空位被中国“朋友”、代理人和企业家所填补，这标志着日本不仅转向真正的自由民主，也在北京的领导下实现了新的联邦统一。

changes.en: The Khmer Rouge came to power in 1975 and have since become China's active allies in the struggle for dominance in Southeast Asia. It was only a year after the regime was established, but the ruling party itself had already split. Two groups with different views on further reforms in Kampuchea have emerged in the leading core: the left wing, consisting of Hu Nim, Hou Yuon and Khieu Samphan, opposes the ideas of the central wing, led by Pol Pot, Nuon Chea and Son Sen, which consist in total collectivisation of all spheres in the country and dividing it into communes. At the moment, the political struggle has entered an active phase and the next month will be decisive in the confrontation between the two factions. However, maybe we should take advantage of this strife and destroy this point of instability in the region with the help of our brave liberation army...?
changes.before: 红色高棉于1975年上台，此后成为中国在争夺东南亚主导权斗争中的积极盟友。政权建立仅仅一年后，执政党本身就已经分裂。围绕柬埔寨后续改革的进一步路线，领导核心中出现了两派观点不同的集团：左翼由胡宁（Hu 宁）、侯宥恩（侯 宥恩）与凯修·桑潘（乔 森潘）组成，反对由波尔布特（波尔布特）、农诺切亚（农谢）与宋森（山 森）领导的中央翼；中央翼主张对国家所有领域进行彻底集体化，并将其划分为公社。此刻，政治斗争已进入活跃阶段，下个月两派对峙将决定胜负。然而，也许我们应该利用这场内斗，在勇敢的解放军帮助下摧毁这一区域的不稳定源头……？

changes.en: In the course of the political struggle Pol Pot decided to implement a cunning and remove the main blow from himself by announcing his ‘illness’, however, under our pressure from 7 September 1976, within a month, Khieu Samphan, the most agreementable of the left wing, was appointed interim Prime Minister of Kampuchea. Having realised whose side the full might of China stood behind, Khieu remained loyal to the left wing of the party and, with its support, Pol Pot was isolated and sent for indefinite ‘treatment’. In October, the centre wing was finally defeated and left wing leader Hu Nim became General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Kampuchea. A party-led planned economy was established in the cities, while in the countryside independent co-operatives were formed, operating on the market principle, ‘as Kampuchea had only recently been a feudal country and was not yet ready for full socialism’. Private property, however, had already been abolished.
changes.before: 在政治斗争过程中，波尔布特决定耍一个狡猾的手段：通过宣布“生病”来移开主要打击。然而在我们对他施压的1976年9月7日之后，仅仅一个月内，左翼中最容易达成一致的人凯修·桑潘被任命为柬埔寨临时首相。凯修意识到中国的全部力量站在谁那一边，于是他对党的左翼保持忠诚，并在其支持下，波尔布特被孤立并被送去接受“无限期治疗”。10月时，中央翼终于被击败，左翼领袖胡宁（Hu 宁）成为柬埔寨共产党中央委员会总书记。城市里建立了由党领导的计划经济；而在乡村则成立独立合作社，按市场原则运作，理由是“柬埔寨只是最近才成为封建国家，尚未准备好全面社会主义”。然而，私有财产早已被废除。

changes.en: To circumvent the Western European blockade, Rigler decided to build bridges with Hungary, in particular with one of its prominent figures, Imre Pozsgay. In the course of negotiations, the two politicians drew up a diplomatic project for the creation of a partnership between Austria and Hungary, which, with the mediation of Otto von Habsburg, evolved into the ‘Pan-European Picnic’ organisation. The aim of the new organisation is to jointly counteract international pressure on the basis of the historical legacy of friendship between Hungarians and Austrians. Formally, the organisation did not violate the programmes of either the COMECON nor the Warsaw Pact, so, despite protests from the USSR, the Hungarian parliament (and later the Austrian parliament) ratified this agreement, beginning an era of a new joint diplomatic, cultural and trade partnership.
changes.before: 为了绕过西欧封锁，里格勒决定与匈牙利搭桥，尤其是与其一位颇具影响力的人物伊姆雷·波兹加伊（伊姆雷·波日高伊）。在谈判过程中，两位政客拟定了一个外交项目：建立奥地利与匈牙利之间的伙伴关系，并在奥托·冯·哈布斯堡（奥托 冯 哈布斯堡）的斡旋下，逐步演变为“泛欧洲野餐”（泛欧洲 野餐）组织。新组织的目标，是在以匈牙利人与奥地利人之间的历史友谊遗产为基础的前提下，共同抵御国际压力。形式上，该组织并未违反经互会（经互会）或华沙条约的任何项目，因此尽管苏联提出抗议，匈牙利议会（随后是奥地利议会）仍批准了这一协议，开启了一个新的共同外交、文化与贸易伙伴关系时代。

changes.en: In the never-ending confrontation with sanctions, Austria continued to drift further and further away from Western Europe. The Social Democratic Party gradually lost its former influence and was replaced by the Austrian People's Party, which firmly took over the left-wing social and green agenda from the Social Democrats, thus becoming culturally right-wing but socially and economically left-wing. The Austrian Freedom Party took over the right-wing economic spectrum, advocating protectionism, keeping foreign enterprises out of the economy, rejecting immigration, supporting a flat tax scale and fighting speculation on currency and other speculations. With the change of the electoral system from proportional to majoritarian, the Social Democrats were finally defeated in the elections and split into left-wing liberals led by Viktor Klima and democratic socialists led by Jörg Leichtfried. Austria eventually became an associate member of the COMECON and an observer of many Asian and Arab organisations, becoming the main bastion of right-wing Euroscepticism in Europe.
changes.before: 在与制裁这场永无止境的对抗中，奥地利继续越走越远离西欧。社会民主党逐渐失去昔日影响力，被奥地利人民党取代。人民党牢牢接过社会民主党留下的左翼社会与绿色议程——因此在文化上偏右翼，但在社会与经济上偏左翼。奥地利自由党则接管了右翼经济光谱，主张保护主义、将外国企业排除在经济之外、拒绝移民、支持统一所得税税率，并与货币投机及其他投机行为作斗争。随着选举制度从比例代表制改为多数代表制，社会民主党在选举中最终被击败，并分裂为以维克托·克拉伊纳（维克托 克利马）为首的左翼自由派，以及以约尔格·莱希特弗里德（约尔格 莱希特弗里德）为首的民主社会主义者。奥地利最终成为经互会（经互会）的准成员，并成为许多亚洲与阿拉伯组织的观察员，成为欧洲右翼欧洲怀疑主义的主要堡垒。

changes.en: After a series of personnel changes, the Congress of the Central Committee of the Hungarian Socialist Party officially adopted a pragmatic version of the "Gábor Bethlen Programme" as the official programme for the coming five-year period. The project envisages cautious economic reforms and a transition to a revival of Hungarian national consciousness within the framework of a "Marxist realisation of the national question". Despite Moscow's guarded protests on the sidelines, Pozhgai reaffirmed Hungary's membership in CMEA and the OVD and even promised Moscow an end to its policy of endless borrowing from the Western powers.
changes.before: 在一系列人事变动之后，匈牙利社会主义党中央委员会代表大会正式通过了“加博尔·贝特伦计划”的务实版本，作为未来五年的官方纲领。该项目设想谨慎的经济改革，并在“以马克思主义实现民族问题”的框架内，向匈牙利民族意识复兴过渡。尽管莫斯科在旁侧提出谨慎的抗议，波兹加伊仍重申匈牙利加入经互会（经济互助委员会）与华沙条约组织（华沙条约组织），甚至还向莫斯科承诺：结束其从西方强权那里进行无休止借贷的政策。

changes.en: After a series of personnel reshuffles, the Congress of the Central Committee of the Hungarian Socialist Party officially adopted the nationalist version of the "Gábor Bethlen Programme" as the official programme for the coming five-year period. The draft envisages semi-syndicalist economic reforms and a move to revive Hungary's national identity "suppressed by centuries of Austrian and German domination". Despite Moscow's guarded protests on the sidelines, Pozhgai reaffirmed Hungary's membership in CMEA and the OVD and even promised Moscow an end to its policy of endless borrowing from Western powers.
changes.before: 在一系列人事调整之后，匈牙利社会主义党中央委员会代表大会正式通过了“加博尔·贝特伦计划”的民族主义版本，作为未来五年的官方纲领。该草案设想半工团主义的经济改革，并推动复兴匈牙利的民族认同——“被数百年的奥地利与德国统治所压制”。尽管莫斯科在旁侧提出谨慎的抗议，波兹加伊仍重申匈牙利加入经互会（经济互助委员会）与华沙条约组织（华沙条约组织），甚至还向莫斯科承诺：结束其从西方强权那里进行无休止借贷的政策。

changes.en: Attempts by Hungary and Austria to start the process of merger, and even more so under a new king, caused serious misgivings from Moscow. Attempts at behind-the-scenes negotiations between Budapest and Moscow failed, and there were no mediators acceptable to both sides. As a result, when the Hungarian authorities openly announced their intention to ratify in the near future the treaty on unification into a confederation with Austria under the single crown of the yet-to-be-elected monarch, Moscow again brought in the tanks. Strangely enough, some of the comrades of the "new Imre Nadja" also defected to the side of the Soviet Union, namely the entire foursome of the reform group co-opted by Pozhgai. There was no resistance and, as a result, Požgai and the entire leadership of the ruling Party were arrested and power passed into the hands of the government formed under the leadership of Borbey. The country tightened censorship and the rights of the law enforcement agencies, re-established the special services, the economy switched back to a planned economy with financial support from Moscow, but in the socio-political sphere nationalist propaganda was launched to pacify the masses. The VSRP was reorganised into the Hungarian Workers' and Peasants' Party and the symbols of the state were returned to the attributes of the Hungarian kingdom, but without the crown and monarchical regalia.|At the same time, practically none of the socialist and communist parties of the world condemned the Soviet troops this time, believing that the reactionary attempt to restore the monarchy and the Austro-Hungarian imperialist experiment was a far more terrible event than another Soviet intervention.
changes.before: 匈牙利与奥地利试图启动合并进程，尤其是在新国王的名义下进行，这引起了莫斯科的严重疑虑。布达佩斯与莫斯科之间的幕后谈判尝试失败了，双方都无法接受任何调停者。结果，当匈牙利当局公开宣布打算在不久的将来批准一项条约：在尚未选出的君主的单一王冠之下，与奥地利统一为邦联时，莫斯科再次出动坦克。更离奇的是，“新伊姆雷·纳贾”（新 伊姆雷 娜佳）的一些同志也叛逃到了苏联一边，也就是波兹加伊所拉拢的改革小组的整个四人组。没有任何抵抗，因此波兹加伊以及执政党的全部领导层被逮捕，政权转交给由博尔贝伊领导组建的政府。该国加强审查制度，收紧执法机构的权利，重新建立特务机关；经济则在莫斯科的财政支持下重新转回计划经济。但在社会政治领域，民族主义宣传被启动以安抚民众。匈牙利工人和劳动人民党（匈牙利社会主义工人党）被改组为匈牙利工人党与农民党，国家象征也被恢复到匈牙利王国的属性之中——但没有王冠与君主制礼仪。|与此同时，实际上世界上几乎没有任何社会主义与共产主义政党这次谴责苏联军队，认为这次反动的企图恢复君主制、重演奥匈帝国的帝国主义实验，比另一场苏联干预更可怕。

changes.en: Now that we have decided on a historical compromise and are granting special autonomy to Tibet with its own government, we should decide who will be recognized by us as the new spiritual and political leader of Tibet. Thus, we have three possible candidates for this post, since only three of them correspond to all religious canons: Panchen Lama X, our religious Tibetan figure, who was subjected to prison persecution and then married a woman of Han origin. The fugitive Dalai Lama XIV, an old political dissident living in India, engaged in active political activity and has long been applying for this post. And the last option is the Soviet Hambo Lama, the spiritual leader of the Soviet Buddhists, an activist of the organization of the struggle for peace and the development of the Buddhist school. In the case of the first option, we have the least amount of risks, with the third option, we risk becoming dependent on the Soviet Union, and the most risky is the second option - despite the statements of the Dalai Lama that he stands only for autonomy, not separatism, he has long-standing contacts with our dissidents and American politicians. The choice is yours.
changes.before: 既然我们已经决定了历史性的折衷，并给予西藏以拥有自己政府的特殊自治，我们就应该决定由我们来承认谁将成为西藏新的宗教与政治领袖。因此，我们有三个可能的候选人，因为只有他们三人符合全部宗教教规：班禅喇嘛X，我们的宗教藏族代表人物，他曾遭受监禁迫害，随后与一位汉族女子结婚。逃亡的达赖喇嘛十四，居住在印度的老牌政治异议人士，积极从事政治活动，并长期申请担任这一职位。最后一个选项是苏联“汉博喇嘛”，苏联佛教徒的宗教领袖，是“争取和平与佛教发展”组织的活动人士。就第一种选项而言，我们的风险最小；第三种选项，我们可能会对苏联产生依赖；最危险的是第二种选项——尽管达赖喇嘛声称他只主张自治而非分裂，但他长期与我们的异议人士以及美国政界人士保持联系。选择权在你。
changes.after: 既然我们已经决定了历史性的折衷，并给予西藏以拥有自己政府的特殊自治，我们就应该决定由我们来承认谁将成为西藏新的宗教与政治领袖。因此，我们有三个可能的候选人，因为只有他们三人符合全部宗教教规：十世班禅，我们的宗教藏族代表人物，他曾遭受监禁迫害，随后与一位汉族女子结婚。逃亡的达赖喇嘛十四，居住在印度的老牌政治异议人士，积极从事政治活动，并长期申请担任这一职位。最后一个选项是苏联“汉博喇嘛”，苏联佛教徒的宗教领袖，是“争取和平与佛教发展”组织的活动人士。就第一种选项而言，我们的风险最小；第三种选项，我们可能会对苏联产生依赖；最危险的是第二种选项——尽管达赖喇嘛声称他只主张自治而非分裂，但他长期与我们的异议人士以及美国政界人士保持联系。选择权在你。

changes.en: Panchen Lama X previously received special support from the wives of Zhou Enlai and Deng Xiaoping, in particular, they saw an excellent political opportunity in creating a marriage of a Tibetan Lama with a Han girl. In the future, Gyaltsen became a deputy of the NPC and began to climb the career ladder of the NPC Permanent Council. And he really became the safest choice for the head of Tibet's own government. While remaining fully loyal to our government, he was primarily engaged in the restoration of old Buddhist temples, the reburial of Buddhist monks and the expansion of spiritual schools. In general, everything is calm in Tibet.
changes.before: 班禅喇嘛X此前曾得到周恩来和邓小平夫人的特别支持，尤其是她们认为：让一位藏传喇嘛与一位汉族女孩结成婚姻，是一个极佳的政治机会。此后，坚赞成为全国人大代表，并开始攀登全国人大常务委员会的事业阶梯。并且他确实成为西藏自治政府首脑最安全的选择。在对我们政府保持完全忠诚的同时，他主要致力于修复旧佛寺、为佛教僧侣重新安葬遗骨，并扩展宗教学校。总之，西藏一片平静。

changes.en: At the next party meeting, the question was raised about the resignation of Chairman Hua Guofeng, on whom all the failures of the country were hung. In the vote, everyone unanimously supported the resignation and soon Guofeng lost his posts and was sent to his dacha, where he would soon die in a few weeks. From natural causes, of course.

changes.en: After heavy fighting on the Kosovo-Metochian Plain and in Macedonia, the leadership of Yugoslavia, under pressure from the Warsaw Pact and NATO (fearing the expansion of the conflict and drawing superpowers into it), was forced to admit defeat and agree with Albanian claims to Kosovo, the Presovo Valley, the western communities of Macedonia and the southern communities Montenegro. The news of this led to thousands of demonstrations in Belgrade demanding «not to give up Kosovo», which were quickly joined by soldiers of the territorial defense and volunteer detachments returning from the front. Taking advantage of the situation, a group of high-ranking officials led by Hamdia Pozderats and Fikret Abdich, with the support of the JNA generals, carried out a coup d'état. A state of emergency was introduced, the entire old leadership of Yugoslavia was arrested, the country announced a break in the agreement with the CMEA, a rejection of the policy of non-alignment and applied to join the EEC, agreeing to a plan for large-scale market reforms. And the Albanian nationalists are celebrating the victory and looking at the Greek Northern Epirus...

changes.en: The situation in Portugal finally stabilized. Despite a prolonged economic downturn, inflation, unemployment and frequent government changes, the popularity of radical parties continues to decline. The pressure on the Revolutionary Council of Portugal has increased - democratic parties and the government have initiated public campaigns in support of its dissolution, since the council is essentially a body that stands above democratic institutions and impedes the development of reforms. {0}The new, democratic Portugal, headed for entry in the EEC and integration with other European countries.

changes.en: {0}The defeat of Yugoslavia in the Kosovo War was a strong blow to the country and provoked a severe political crisis, but the new leadership, with the support of the JNA generals, was able to retain power by force and suppress the speeches of Slovenian and Croatian separatists. Throughout the 80s and 90s, large-scale reforms were carried out in the SFRY: there was a departure from Titoism and partial liberalization in politics (a limited multi-party system was allowed while maintaining the leading role of the SKJ, transformed into a Eurocommunist party, some of the Chetniks and even some Ustashe and Bosniak nationalists were rehabilitated, the system of councils and assemblies was simplified), the economy underwent a transition to a regulated market economy with the privatization of enterprises by their employees. This initially caused significant social problems, but then allowed to pay off the external debt and resume economic growth. At the same time, the influence of the Muslim Bosniaks noticeably increased in the renewed federation: under the Pozderats-Abdić duumvirate, they occupied over 60% of the leading positions, which causes deaf discontent of other peoples. In foreign policy, the SFRY is deepening cooperation with the EEC (which it was finally admitted to in 1995) and the Arab world, while refusing to recognize territorial changes and periodically threatening Albania with either sanctions or the threat of war.
changes.before: {0}科索沃战争中南斯拉夫的失败给该国造成了沉重打击，并引发严重的政治危机；但在南斯拉夫人民军（南斯拉夫人民军）将军的支持下，新领导层得以凭借武力保住政权，并压制斯洛文尼亚与克罗地亚分离主义者的发声。整个80年代与90年代，南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国（南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国）进行了大规模改革：从铁托主义转向，并在政治上进行部分自由化（在保持南斯拉夫共产主义者联盟主导地位的同时，允许有限的多党制；南斯拉夫共产主义者联盟被改造成欧洲共产主义政党；部分切特尼克甚至一些乌斯塔沙与波斯尼亚克民族主义者获得平反；委员会与议会制度被简化）。经济方面则转向受监管的市场经济，并由员工对企业进行私有化。起初这引发了显著的社会问题，但随后使外债得以偿还，并恢复经济增长。与此同时，在重建后的联邦中，穆斯林波斯尼亚克的影响力明显上升：在波兹德拉茨-阿卜迪奇二人执政（波兹德拉茨—阿布迪ć）之下，他们占据了超过60%的关键职位，这引来其他民族的强烈不满。在外交政策上，南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国深化与欧洲经济共同体（欧洲经济共同体）的合作（其最终于1995年被正式接纳），并加强与阿拉伯世界的联系，同时拒绝承认领土变更，并定期以制裁或战争威胁阿尔巴尼亚。

changes.en: Germany continued to exist as a confederal state. At first, different currencies were in circulation, and even duties were introduced on goods in order to balance the competitiveness of industries. After the start of reforms in the Soviet Union, Erich Honecker resigned and handed over the leadership of the party to Hans Modrow, who became the architect of the reforms. Against the background of the general democratization of Germany and the stabilization of the situation, the popularity of the CDA fell and the SPD won the elections in West Germany.{0}The governments of both Germanys decided to move towards further integration of the countries into a soft federation with the creation of a national parliament and government.
changes.before: 德国继续以邦联国家形式存在。起初，不同货币在流通，甚至为了平衡各工业的竞争力，还对商品征收关税。苏联开始改革后，埃里希·霍内克辞职，并将党的领导权交给汉斯·莫德罗，后者成为改革的设计者。随着德国总体民主化与局势稳定，基督教民主党的支持率下滑，而德国社会民主党在西德赢得了选举。{0}两德政府决定进一步推动两国向“软联邦”整合：通过建立全国议会与政府。

changes.en: Vietnamese troops, supported by units of the United Front for National Salvation of Kampuchea, easily defeated the Kampuchean army and occupied Phnom Penh. The Vietnamese, in agreement with the USSR, put Heng Samrin and Pen Sovan, former Khmer Rouge who had opposed Pol Pot and had been forced to emigrate, at the head of the new People's Republic of Kampuchea; now advocates of Soviet-style socialism, reforms along those lines were already underway, while a large Vietnamese military contingent remained in the country.{0}The new authorities are also preparing a tribunal against the old regime and collecting evidence of "the work of Pol Pot and his bloody clique for the US imperialists and Beijing revisionists". The remnants of the Khmer Rouge forces have retreated into the impenetrable jungle and to the border with Thailand, where they have turned to guerrilla warfare. It is known that negotiations are underway between PDFGNUK Khieu Sampfang (Khmer Rouge), General Son Sann's KPNLF (pro-US Republicans) and Prince Norodom Sihanouk's FUNSINPEC (monarchists) to establish a coalition government and unified military command. However, as long as Vietnam supports the PRC - they will not win.
changes.before: 在柬埔寨救国统一战线的部队支持下，越南军队轻易击败柬埔寨军队并占领金边。越南在与苏联达成协议后，将亨·萨姆林和彭索万——这两位曾反对波尔布特、并被迫移居的前红色高棉成员——推到新柬埔寨人民共和国的领导位置；如今他们主张苏联式社会主义，相关改革已在推进中，同时仍有大量越南军事力量留在该国。{0}新当局也在准备对旧政权进行审判，并收集“波尔布特及其为美国帝国主义和北京修正主义效力的血腥集团”的证据。红色高棉武装残部退入难以穿透的丛林以及与泰国的边境地带，并转入游击战。人们知道，柬埔寨爱国民主民族大团结阵线的凯乌·桑潘（红色高棉）、索恩·山将军的高棉人民民族解放阵线（亲美的共和派）以及诺罗敦·西哈努克亲王的奉辛比克党（君主派）正在进行谈判，试图建立联合政府并统一军事指挥。然而，只要越南支持中华人民共和国——他们就赢不了。
